FANTASTIC APP. It is such a good feeling to know what bird is making the various sounds on my patio. I try to wait until only one is chattering you make it easier to identify. Wonderful app. So interesting to expand my knowledge of nature.
Great apps!. It’s great to have with you!!

Worthless. I’ve had this app for more than a year and tried it in all kinds of setting. Totally worthless. It doesn’t even ID common birds like cardinals, when I have tested it in birds that I know well. Don’t bother.

Disappointing. Not sure how this app has such a high rating. It’s not at all intuitive to use, and the suggested IDs rarely seem plausible. Sorry I wasted my money on it. App developers, there’s a goldmine for the team that makes a truly great birdsong or call recognition app.
Perfect for Me. As a brand new bird watcher this app is just what I was looking for. Local bird club recommended and doesn’t disappoint.

Waste of money. I really wanted this to help me identify birdsongs while hiking. It has never worked. Even when I had a clear recording, It apparently didn’t have the bird in it’s limited repertoire. Great App A++++. Easy to use, fun!
What a cool app!. Very fun to use, and it has a variety of different features. Well worth it - I would highly recommend!
Great tool. Bird songs help me confirm which bird I hear and see. This app makes it easy for a beginner like me.
Clumsy but works. After frustration from a poorly designed interface I figured out how to make it work. A useful tool bit hoping they improve it or someone else comes on the scene.

Not worth it. On three separate occasions, I recorded the song of birds I was literally looking at and could easily identify. They were a Carolina Wren, a crow, and an Eastern Bluebird. The audio quality of the bluebird recording may have not been great, so I’ll even give a pass for that one, but the other two were very close and crystal clear, especially the wren. This app misidentified all of them. This completely shot my confidence in the apps ability to accurately tell me what bird I was listening to. Don’t waste your time.
Tom Thompson. Makes it nice to watch the birds at the feeders and be able to identify them easily
Love it!. This app is very informative and we love the bird songs and calls. The birds off our porch love them, too!!
Waste of money!. This app does not identify birds by their song as promised.

Not happy. I find the app useless, even a close-up 30 sec recording doesn’t give me any meaningful ID.
Extremely disappointed. This app is useless. It cannot pick up clear bird sounds.

Poor recording identification. BirdSong was loud and well recorded. I could see the bird 15 feet away yet this app could not identify. I’m not in some remote part of the Amazon so I think it’s a fairly common song.
 Don’t buy If you want to use for using birdsong identity option!
There are no plain chacalaccas in New Jersey. This is bad software

Recorder is useless. I bought this to identify my backyard birds from their songs, and for that purpose this app is a complete waste of money, it has yet to accurately identify a single bird song from my recordings. The app complains that the quality of my recordings is poor and it seems unless the bird is singing directly into your phone this will be the case, because even if it’s just the one bird singing fairly loudly and no other background noise, my recording is still not good enough. There is no way to edit your recording to cut out extra birds, and even their own recorded examples will sometimes have extraneous birds chiming in so you don’t know what you’re supposed to be hearing. The manual ID feature is a joke, I’ve gotten wide-ranging suggestions from owl to heron to sparrow for a single entry. I don’t know how they come up with their percentage accuracy but these too are a joke because they are wildly inaccurate. I also know that some birds have multiple calls/songs but the app does not give more than one of each. Don’t waste your money on this one.
Great app so far. Great app

Very finicky. When you are able to get a good ID it’s great, however it’s very few and far between. There cannot be any background noise at all otherwise you’ll get a poor recording error, which fir me seems to be most of the time. I’ve also noticed it favors certain birds, tho if you listen to their songs they sound nothing like the bird I’m hearing whatsoever.

Largely Useless. As consistent as bird sings tend to be, and with apps like SoundHound able to pick out and match even obscure tunes, you would figure that someone would develop an app to identify birds. Well, worry no more: if it exists, this isn’t it! BirdSongID is so picky about the quality of recordings to the point where they certainly can’t be blamed for failing to identify even the most basic bird calls. Record for a minute and it’ll warn you you need to record for thirty seconds. And short of crawling up in the tree and being right next to the bird, it will tell you your recording quality is poor. Its ability to discriminate bird songs from one another is non-existent. Don’t bother with this app: it’s a waste of both time and money.
Great app.. It is correct the majority of the time
BirdSongId USA. Great images but hard to get my recordings identified. Also not sure how to do the quiz. The prerecorded calls and songs are very clear and helpful.

Never works - don’t waste your money. This app has never identified a bird for me. It always says the recording isn’t good enough. For this to work you would need to be right beneath the bird, record it for 30 seconds, without any other bird noises. That isn’t realistic.
No thanks. I am not at all satisfied with this app. I have followed your directions. It’s just not working as I expected. Please refund my money. Stella McDonald. Smyrna TN

Stopped recording altogether. The apps record button no longer works. Privacy settings were set accordingly to allow this app access. When I bought it 3 seasons ago, it worked fine. Now, when the record button is pushed, it idles and times out. Last update was 2 years ago. The developers aren’t maintaining it. Nothing. Useless. Very unhappy as I paid $10 for this defunct app.

No, it’s not Shazam for birds. I can’t believe I paid money for this app. The description that they put in had a quote saying it was Shazam for birds. It isn’t. I’ve tried recording 4-5 different times, all loud recordings with minimal noise in the background (crickets, birds much farther away, an occasional car from a road farther away), and not one ever got analyzed. When I looked at the list that’s included in the automatic recognition, it’s so minimal. There is no way you at this is Shazam for birds when that list is so short. There is a much larger database included in the app with recordings, but unless you want to scroll through a hundred or so birds and listen to each one, you will not find what you are looking for. I feel like I got swindled and I want my money back.

reviews.text: Missing many birds! Poorly organized!. This app is dreadful. Does not list many common species, e.g. whippoorwill!

Love it but want more. It’s great. As you improve over the coming years, please make a version that continuously listens, shows likely birds from the last analyzed audio segment in a scrolling fashion and keeps summary statistics by location. 

We live on a migratory fly way and have so many birds in our yard.

Recording to identify doesn’t work. I’ve tried numerous times to record/identify bird calls, which is the main reason I got this app. It flat out doesn’t work. Perhaps if there was a single bird calling, non-stop, with no background noise whatsoever, I’d have better luck. But when does that ever happen? Note: the bird calls I’m recording are the dominant sound & I have made 30 second recordings. Very disappointing.

Good for most common birds. We have used this app to identify, or verify our hunch about, perhaps 4 or 5 common birds in our area. However, there are still some that just are not in the database. We don’t use the recording feature, instead we browse the listing making best guesses as to the type of bird. I’d like to see the number of birds identified increased.

Don’t waste your $, do your homework first!. Not being given a free trial first should have sent alarms going off in my head before I paid money for this app. I can only blame myself for not researching this App first.
A) Only 8 warblers? I’ve seen over 25 in Connecticut!
B) The App hasn’t been updated in over 2 years!
C) The App isn’t regionally specific. I doubt I’ll see a road-runner or Chachalaca in the Northeast.
D) Some birds are included that even a non-Birder can recognize by sight and/or sound... (Osprey, Kingfisher, Hummingbird)

It seems the developers have given up on this program. Although the record a sound feature is catchy, the data base is extremely limited and ineffectual.
Waste of money. I very seldom leave bad reviews. Until now. Too difficult and clumsy to use. Not impressed.
Super app!. Helps a lot with I.D. Easy to use!
Useless. Had a House wren 10 feet away sing 3 times during the recording and it never even brought it up as a guess. No way would this be useful with songs I don’t know.
Disappointed. I have not once had a pristine enough recording to identify any bird. Wish I could get my money back.

Basically never identifies correctly. Even in the rare case when it deems a recording good enough it more or less always thinks any sound is a Brown Thrasher or often other birds not even present here (and yes app knows my location and many of the birds are loud and clear). The UI is also a bit weird... keeps going to the save recording page with no back button and similar bad navigation design. I am going to uninstall so I stop wasting my time with this app.
Bird nerd. The app is finicky about sound quality when trying to record bird calls to identify species. Sometimes it works...sometimes it doesn’t.

A real disapointment. I’ve used this app off and on for over 6 months and I’d guess 65% of my recordings come back as poor quality even though the bird is singing in the tree next to me. Maybe an auxillary mic would help. But when I get a good recording, which is about 1/3 of the time, it has never correctly identified the bird. I mean never as in not even once. This week I play some simple bird songs (the Easter Phoebe for example) from Merlin (another app) and this app couldn’t identify even perfectly recorded bird songs. My only advice is if you use it, and you don’t know your birdsongs, don’t trust this app to help you. You’d be better off taking the results and using them to eliminate what bird you heard. And FWIW, I’ve never rated an app 1 star before. As I said, this is a real disapointment.
Love this app. It’s worth every penny. I love calling my bluebirds to the feeder every morning. It works like a charm! 💙💙
Don’t waste your money. Recorded a northern cardinal, quiet surroundings in my backyard and app could not recognize it. I don’t leave reviews often but this is an easy one.

About the most user UNFRIENDLY app ever.. It makes no logical sense. Nothing is intuitive and I found it useless and unusable. As well birds that were 15 feet away, it doesn’t recognize. I can’t believe it got any stars. How do I get my money back?

Doesn’t work. As reported by others, this app doesn’t work at all. Maybe if you were perched in the tree and the bird is 3 feet away from you it might pick up sound but I was hoping that I could sit on my lanai and record the songs of birds that are not more than 20 feet from me with crystal clear sound but no. Not a single ID.

Refund please?. Waste of time and money. Once you wade through and finally find the ID part of the app, then figure out how to record, it just shows a list of common birds in the area. I was trying to ID a specific call. It was clear and loud, no background noise. The bird I expected wasn't even on the list. It couldn't even ID a mourning dove!
Always accurate. Found this to be very good and easy to use

Missed distinctive Whip-poor-will. I have tried this app for several weeks, and it has successfully identified a bird only once. I live in the woods with little background noise, so recording bird song is fairly easy to do. Identification using this app is not. Last night, I recorded a single bird sound from a short distance. I knew it was a whippoorwill, but the app didn’t, even though the recording was strong. Turns out, the distinctive whippoorwill is not in its database. Why does my database list only 183 bird sounds, not the 240+ advertised?

I thought the app would save my recordings, so I could replay them later for friends, but “my recordings” is empty. Why?

The app is not user-friendly at all, but I hope the developers answer my questions so I can get more enjoyment from their app.

Newbie friendly. I am new to bird watching and bird songs and this has been a great support in helping me identify. I had heard the song of Wilson Snipe, very intriguing, didn’t know what bird it was until this APP.

Nice app for finding out more about the birds in your area.. Haven’t used very much, but so far I do like what I’ve seen (and heard). I’ll try to update later after a month or two of utilizing the app.
It's fantastic!. I couldn’t figure out what this one bird was so I downloaded the app. It told me that it was a Mockingbird and it was! Get this app. You won’t be disappointed.
Like the app.. Enjoying seeing the birds in my yard and looking them up.

Useless!. I have very clear recordings ask for ID, it returned birds that are not even close! Example I recorded a woodpecker that I know by sound already this returned house finches. Really? Not even close! Stinks.

Doesn't seem to work at all. I had a very loud distinct bird call that I recorded in the Automatic Recognition section and there were No suggested birds no matter how many times I tried and also moved the iPhone around. Then I tried with an easy Chickadee and still no suggestions. A total waste of money.
Bird calls. Great program, easy to use, I use it all of the time.

Helpful and easy to use. In field, as always in field, less than optimal conditions sometimes cause frustration but in general I have been pleased with the app, and use it frequently. It feels great to identify an unfamiliar call!
Fun App!. Enjoy calling in the birds with this application.

Very Useful App. Many times I've wanted to figure out what bird was chirping or singing in the woods or across a field. This App has been very useful for that, and has helped me learn to recognize quite a few bird songs as well as bird identifications.

Very confusing. I’ve used the app a number of times now but still find the interface bizarre and confusing. What is with the quiz screen in manual ID with the eye and numbers in the corners? Where did my recording go? Why did all the bird options for my automatic recognition disappear after I played the first one? I’ve managed to ID some birds by listening to the recordings and so the catalog of bird songs is useful, but otherwise this is very frustrating. Please fix the interface.

Garbage app.. I purchased the bundle and am not pleased at all. It’s not user friendly and the bird calls don’t even play. I want a refund! Do not purchase. There are free apps that are way better than any of these!!

Doesn’t work...EVER. Got this app to identify a bird I keep hearing in my back yard. I followed instructions and have tried dozens of times but the result is always the same: “no bird was detected on this recording” Refund Please!
Backyard Birder. With this app I’ve been able to ID the vocals of a number our feathered friends.

Not worth it- don’t waste your money. I really wish there was a free trial period option for this app because I would have been able to see how useless it is and not wasted $4.99. 

If there is ANY background noise whatsoever it will tell you it’s poor quality and then pull up a random list of possible birds. The app is unable to correctly identify a Northern Cardinal for crying out loud- I mean those guys have loud and very distinguishable songs. 

Don’t waste your time or your money, you’ll end up being frustrated and not learning anything. 
Go to ebird dot com and search their massive library, better luck figuring it out by process of elimination than trying to with this app.
Mixed. Still experimenting. Not sure yet.

Ineffective. I got this app because I was trying hard to identify a bird that I keep hearing a unique call sound for but can never see the bird. I find this app rather picky about the quality length and loudness of the recording made. I did not have trouble finding the record button like some have complained about. But I have made sample after sample of the bird song and I keep getting warnings about too short, poor sound quality, not loud enough, and then when I think I got one that matches their picky criteria it comes up with a list of birds that have no resemblance to what I recorded. The UI/UX is clunky and strange at best. Sometimes the play button has no stop button, and sometimes it does. There’s no way to edit the length of the song sample to eliminate other birds that are chiming in. After you have it analyzed the song it gives you a list of bird choices. If you pick one to listen to their recording of it and decide that’s not the one... if you go back, your choices are add it to the library or you can listen to your recording again but you can’t analyze it and get your list back it appears. If you close this window because you’re not ready to add it since you didn’t find the bird, it will toss your recording. lt’s just a wacky app and a waste of five dollars. I wished I could get my five dollars back as it couldn’t even ID one bird call.
Disappointment. I’ve been trying to download this app for days but I cannot! It is a disappointment to buy something & not be able to open it!

Not an accurate app whatsoever.. I had high hopes when I got this app, but I was greatly disappointed when I realized the app was essentially just guessing the most common birds around me. To test this, I played a variety of different bird calls from another phone and had this app try to identify them, sure enough, it just kept suggesting common birds like the cardinal, goldfinch, and robin. I suppose the app is probably right some of the time, given how common those birds are... but it’s purely because of luck.

I will say though, at least you can play the bird calls on this app to check if it sounds the same. (Though the answer is usually no.) That’s the only thing saving this review from being 1-Star.

I wasted money on this app. If you’re an aspiring birder, it seems there is still no great method to identify bird calls other than just looking up possible candidates the slow way.

Wish it was better. The interface is not intuitive - i would expect the recording feature (the whole point of the app) to be front and center. 

Conditions have to be absolutely perfect to get a decent recording. The best I’ve gotten is a “fair” recording (and 0 matches) even if it’s quiet and the call is clear.

Bird song Id. I find this app very frustrating. I fully recognize the difficulty of having an app recognize a call or song, but I have tried it on calls that I know and that I don’t know. What I tend to get is “song not analyzed, with analyzed spelled wrong! The producers of this could and should have done much better.

Missing birds & features. Missing some common eastern birds e.g. rose belly grosbeak, cooper’s hawk among others. Also any misspelling and search is useless. Forget getting a good enough recording to identify a bird. One star because of the above and high price.

Fun to Listen to Songs. I like listening to the calls and songs, then trying to identify the sounds I’m hearing. The microphone recorder on the phone doesn’t work so well so it seems to have trouble reviewing the recordings.

Birds-gone. Worthless. Save your money and time. Once you figure out what to actually do it requires 30 seconds of uninterrupted song to make an ID, and it self shuts off at any point the sound is inadequate, which is always. Never had it ID anything.

Anne. Great app!

Does not identify birds correctly.. Maybe it just is not designed for Pacific NW birds. Even with ideal recording conditions it can’t identify correctly. I am just going to erase the app.

Not accurate. I think I'd have to be sitting in the nest for this app to get a recording with enough quality for this app to identify the bird.

Meh. I just got this app, so I’m still figuring it out, BUT it seems like a bird song identification app should be more straightforward. The record button isn’t on the first screen, and overall the app seems dated. I’ve used it twice to record birdsong: it correctly matched the birdsong once. Hoping I can use it more to learn about birds in my area.

Doesn't work. It seems like there is a market for an app like this pretends to be, but this doesn't work. Even after navigating the poorly designed interface to the automatic bird ID by call area I couldn't get it to work. Good recording of the call, but not close on I'd.

Pretty good but could use a search function. As somebody who doesn’t know bird families (which family is the mockingbird in?) and sometimes not full official names (is it the “Eastern Barn Owl” or just “Barn Owl”?) I could really use a search function to complement the index. 

Also, the song recognition could benefit from a differentiation between calls and songs as there is in the rest of the app. 

What is there is good, but it could be better.

A simple to use App - it's like Shazam for birds!. This app is really great as it does what it says. It automatically recognizes birds by their songs and calls. You only need to press the auto rec button in the middle of the main screen. This clever little helper will immediately helps to identify the bird singing in your backyard. The clearly arranged design makes the app very easy to use. You can choose from two screens how you like to group the birds. Either by name or by bird group. I prefer the group view as it is reasoned and the images are larger and I love to browse between all these different birds. I am not a birding expert but I always liked to know what’s around me. Thanks to the app this has changed! It was a nice way to become - or at least to feel like - the bird expert in your neighborhood. I always loved to track down the birds in my backyard. In the past I used a book for identifying birds but of course there were no sounds in the book and unlike a book on a shelf, I always have the app with me on my iPhone. Besides the nice automatic song and call recognition the app also comes with a lot of additional information for all the different birds. It has many nice and informative images and all the bird songs and calls. There is also a quiz in it and you can collect your own recordings. By using this app I’ve already learned quite a number of new birds. It can sometimes be a little tricky to find a quiet spot to record but then it really works well! Shazam for birds I would call it! Sometimes I don’t actually see the singing bird but thanks to the images in the app I still learn how it really looks like. That's how I became the chief backyard birder of my family.

Poor. Perhaps it might work if I were able to get within 3 ft. of a singing bird, and there wasn’t any background noise. I have tried several times to ID a bird that was singing its heart out, but the App failed to ID it in each case. The software is NOT user friendly.

Great concept!. What a cool concept to record and compare bird sounds! Yes, I agree with others, it is a bit unfriendly, but I just played around with it to see how things work. I’m still learning the system, but over all it is doing what it says. Sometimes the recording quality message appears and I don’t know why, perhaps because there are multiple birds calling at once. I hope the developers keep working on it! This, in conjunction with the Audubon app are going to make spring and summer much more fun!
Yes. Very helpful and easy for newbies
Great app. Songs are clear and well composed. Accurate. This app is one of m favorites

Bird genie,ID bird songs. I bought this hoping for an easy solution 
It is far from being perfect. Hoping with future updates this app may yet prove to be very valuable in the field. It is a great idea.
Buyer beware. This is not recommended. The songs and calls do not play. Totally a waste.

reviews.text:
Needs recording improvement. It has yet to iD a bird for me
. The recording must need to be ultra pristine which is difficult even deep in the woods with aircraft background sound.
Great learning!. Fun tool, easy for me and my kids to use!
I can't believe this high rating!. I recorded a very clear, loud bird call, and it couldn't ID it. I tried a couple more. This app is useless, don't Get it!

Not the most user friendly - Helpful nevertheless. Although this is not the most user friendly, as mentioned - it is still very useful and does what it advertises. I too would like a better system to guide the user and update their sound recognition software to keep it in line with the ever improving technology. Otherwise I would have added the fifth star.

Yes. I agree with the comment, automatic recognition should be a right up front button for record/recognize so that one can capture the song, often only brief songs are available, and the bird and its song are gone before the, frustrating attempt to record it, is accomplished. Recognize should be a simple button that records instantly, and asks questions secondly.
Not so good. I find the layout is user friendly and the overall concept is great. However, this app does not accurately identify birds, which is its main purpose.

interesting. This is an interesting app - the only clunky thing about it so far is that it takes more keystrokes than makes sense to access the record function. The birds don't tend to wait around as you look for the function.

Difficult to use. I am unhappy to report that this app is so unintuitive that it isn't useful. You have to go through several steps to make a recording, and by that time the bird has gone. Once, I managed a recording that was deemed "high quality" by the app and was then presented with what seemed to be a list of common backyard birds, none of which remotely resembled the recorded call.
Good good for the novice. Help to identify birds less common
BirdSong. Loving this app. I hear so many songs & wanted to know which birds were singing. Very helpful!
Works good, easy. Works good, easy to use
Love it. Great app.

Pretty good!. Just started using the app and its helpful but doesn't have all the songs or calls. I wish I could look up by call or song signature. When I hear a song and can't see the bird, I would like to find which bird sings by its song.
Great App for Bird Lover's. Worth twice the price. Hey, wait! I did pay twice the price! Extremely satisfied, too.
Fascinating. This is very useful and entertaining. It has made me highly aware of all the birds singing outside and encouraged me to watch them.
Awesome. You have to be in a quiet area with little background noise. This works! I have identified several birds over the summer

Very good!. There are all kinds of apps, but there are few, in my opinion, that brings us closer to nature than those that help remind us how beautiful nature can be. Thanks to the Ornithologist at Bird Song for bringing us closer to that natural beauty of the original "song."
Very Good for my purpose. This is an app that is easy to use and very helpful to me.
Worth the investment. Works well. Helpful.

Amazing!. I did the cardinal call and one actually came! So 
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Very enjoyable app. This app has helped me identify birds in my back yard and it's been a lot of fun!
Good apo. Works as advertised for a novice. Probably not enough federal for an advanced birder
Bird Song works in my back yard. I live along the river and have many different birds. With BirdSongId, I have been able to identify the birds in my backyard. It's a good app.
Does the job. Good app
Excellent!. Enjoy the bird identifier very much.

I am so disappointed.. I read the Shazam feature and thought that when I went outside the app would recognize my bird. This is no better than my other apps for song recognition. I don't want to bother to record I want the app to have at least a general idea of what Bird I'm listening to NOW
Excellent app, helpful to identify bird songs & sounds.. Very useful.
Bryon M. Been very happy. Gives great sounds and simple to use
Great ap. Enjoy using this ap. Great for finding and becoming acquainted with birds.
Very fun app. Overall quite useful, fun app.

User unfriendly. I specifically bought this app to ID bird songs in my backyard and assumed it would do just that since "ID automatic recognition" is in the app's title. Unfortunately, it took me a while to figure out how to create a recording in order to identify the song. The ID function is there, but buried under layers of taps, so it's definitely NOT the primary function of this app. If you were to put the ID/auto-recognition function on the home page and readily accessible that would be an improvement. For now, I feel that I have wasted my money.
Paul from PA. Exactly what I wanted. Excellent app
Generally pretty good. A bit counter-intuitive but useful.
Great App. This app works really well in identifying birds!

Want my money back. Not only was the app difficult to figure out how to use but is useless in recognizing birds. Not only did it not properly recognize two recordings of birds in my yard, but then I played bird songs from the Audubon Birds app on another device and this app failed to recognize 5 out of 5 birds! Waste of money!
Terrible App!. The library of birds is puny and it's ability to use your recordings is weak as a result. Very unuser friendly. I would like my money back!
Won't work. I paid $5 for this app and it does not work. I even played a bird song from another device right up next to it and it showed no recognition. Wish I could get my money back!
Very poor app. The audio recordings are hollow and distant. The index is not user friendly. I'd really like my $4.99 back.
Amazing. This is amazing! Has so many birds by area and is great for beginners and experts.
Useful. Still learning how to use it!

Terrible. Very difficult app to use. There are so many tabs and the navigation is confusing. It was difficult to figure out how to record, search and save bird songs. There is no way to search by region which is annoying because it shows you birds that aren't near you. This app needs a major UX overhaul, especially for something as complex as recording and identifying bird calls.

The Shazam of bird song. I really enjoy this app. It does have issues when multiple types of birds are singing, overall it really can help you figure things out. I like that it gives you a percentage match rate and easy access to all the possible birds photos and details. Another great feature is the ability to add onto your recording to get a better match possibility.

Great ID if you have clear loud audio. Main feature is the song ID, which works great if - and it is a big if - you can get a clear, loud recording. The UI could use a lot of help, but this is a free app, so it gets a big break on the rating there. Even without automatic birdsong identification, the app is a lot of fun to play with to listen to bird calls and learn to recognize them by ear.

Frustrating and inaccurate. I appreciate that the developers are trying to do something very difficult. It's also a very cool idea! I liked the interface they developed, the graphics were good, and I think it might have become fairly easy to use once you got used to it. But-

1. It was really hard to figure out how to record a bird's song from the main screen. That's what I bought this app for!

2. Once I got to where I could record birdsong, the app failed to record. Seriously, the on board voice memo app did better. This app requires you to record for 30 seconds, but it shuts down in less than a second with a failure message. For the record, what I was trying to record was a house wren singing nearby. If you know those little guys, you know how loud they are! The voice memo app recorded him perfectly.

3. Then I randomly looked up "Osprey". The range information given was not accurate.

I hope iBird Northeast will still work after the latest iPhone update. That's a solid, simple app with accurate information. This one is a great idea that doesn't work well in practice.
Functional but clunky. Helps with identification. Could use some user interface improvement.

Nice app. Love the bird sound identification feature once I figured out how to us it. Wasn't to tricky, but instructions on how to use it isn't real clear. Helped me in identifying a bird I was hearing I hadn't heard before. Worth the download.

Singing companions. We moved to a 4 1/2 acre farm. There are several bird families here. With this ap we are able to identify them from their song. That allowed us to look them up in the picture identity. Now when we see them we know who they are and their song.

Awesome. Had a bird singing dawn to dusk outside the window Bird ID helped me figure out whjch family and bird

On the money
love it!!!. Just what I was looking for to ID birds while hiking.

Priorities Mixed Up. I bought this app to ID bird calls FIRST AND FOREMOST, and that should be what I see FIRST! The first time I tried to use it, the bird was gone before I could find the REAL purpose of the app. While listening to bird calls is informative on the app, it's NOT why I purchased the app! Please upgrade the app to have its Advertised Function front and center! It does work, just not easily while in the field and that was its advertised function.
Good App!. It's a fun reference and has actually helped me to identify birds. Also just fun to explore.
Thank you!. Love being able to "put a name with a face". Thank you for the assist!
Very useful!. We've had this app only a short time and have already identified many birds with it.
Great App. This has been a huge help in identifying the birds that are outside my window! Wish it was more complete or had different areas that you could buy as an add on

Doesn't work. Fake reviews.. This app completely fails on identifying Bird songs. I can only surmise that any positive review was from employees or paid reviewers. The positive reviews do sound like ads not real people. I lead bird walks and help teach bird ID and this app can't even get common, clear, obvious Bird songs right. The layout of the app makes it look like someone in a 3rd world country put it together that never even has been to USA. Chachalaca as a bird family? As someone that communicates with thousands of beginner birders on a regular basis I will let them know to steer clear of this app.

Almost. I like this a lot, but find navigation difficult. There are many times when there's too much other noise to get a clear recording, and the manual look up is cumbersome. Organization by families is not useful for many (probably most) of us. 

 This morning I heard three fledglings with a call that was new to me. My best guess was they were cowbirds. They were gone before I could record. I opened the app- which is organized by bird family and I had no idea what the cowbird family is. No search function on the first page, but an index. 

So I tried the index, only to find it too is organized by family rather than name- not useful at all!! I started to dig through and finally found the cowbird under Icterid. Too much work!!

Only later did I figure out that I had to go through a family to find the Search function. Please either put the search function on the 1st page, or organize the index by name. Re-do this and I'm change my rating to 5 stars. 

And yes, they were cowbirds. What a curious call!!
Great app. Love this app!

Very cool!. This is a great app for deciphering bird calls. It's extremely accurate...actually, mind blowingly accurate. I would highly recommend this app to anyone who enjoys learning about different birds as they come and go each season. My only suggestion to the developers would be that they reorganize some of the features as they can be a bit tricky to land on, especially when time is of the essence which is often the case when trying to capture a bird's song or call.
Good app. Enjoy it.

Great app for visual learners. I use this app to learn bird songs before I go out in the field. I can look at the picture and hear the song. I am just a beginner so it might not be a good tool for a more advanced birder to identify an unfamiliar song heard in the field. I use it and enjoy it-thanks!
Don't waste your $. Do not waste your money. Every recording no matter how close you are to the bird (even 6 feet away) comes up as "poor recognition ".
Great database of bird calls .... ... but the microphone recognition is splotchy.
Wonderful. I enjoy very much having this app.

Work in progress. They're getting there ... but still have a ways to go before the ID feature is easy & reliable. To be fair, recording quality from a phone with lots of background noise is not great. Plus, birds have accents. A titmouse in DC doesn't quite sound like the titmouse in the recording. That makes the problem fundamentally different than music ID apps like Shazam. Still, the developers make *usage* difficult an unintuitive. That, they have control over ... and should work to improve.
It works. A complex process but it works and that's what counts
Helpful app. This app will help you get better at identifying birds songs.
Progress. It just keeps getting better!
Great. It really taught me a lot about nature

Nope. This App purports to be Bird Song ID, yet that feature is buried after several screen taps under My Recordings. Even when you tap "My Recordings," nothing is obvious about what to do next. So you fumble around finding Add Recording. Finally you see a tab that says Automatic Recognition. It is simply not Field Friendly. "Automatic Recognition" should be the first thing you see when you open up the app...a big button to hit like Shazam. When you hear a bird you can't identify, it does not give you the time to 1. Get the phone out, 2. Find the app on your phone, 3. Then wade through screens until you find the hidden buttons to do what you need. By that time, the bird has flown. There are other inexplicable aspects of the App: Bird Families. Here's what I see on the first screen, stuff like Cardinal (not a bird family), Chickadee (not a bird family), Chachalaca (really? on the first screen? What are my chances of happening across a Chachalaca?) Good idea, but ill-conceived. Developers should make the primary function of this App "Auto Recognition" then put a large button in the middle of the screen that starts that process with a single tap.
Really special, educational and FUN app, kudos to all responsible for it!. Really special, educational and FUN App, kudos to all of you who are responsible for creating it!
Love it. Easy to use
Great app. Love this app. This helps us identify birds by their song when we're unable to view them. Love the information about the bird species in our area.
Love this app. We live on top of a Mountain and this is an invaluable aid to discover the world of birds around us.
Love this app. I just wish it allowed us to keep track of our sightings.

doesn't work. Hasn't been able to identify a single bird yet.
I've been in the woods with no wind and nothing but birds singing. Still nothing.
Educational and fun!. Helps us identify the birds in our backyard by their call and appearance. Great app!!

I want my $5 back. I am having exact same experience as the other negative reviewers. The calls couldn't be clearer yet the app is unable to identify a single COMMON bird. I even played a call on my computer in a quiet room with the app on record. That is an ideal lab condition. It failed. So if anyone else buys this app after reading this review it must be because you want to waste $5. This app is beyond awful. Developers did not test it. I want my money back!!!!!!!
Good App. Seems to work fine.

Not very helpful. Like some other users, the app always claims poor audio quality. For instance a couple of Canadian geese flew overhead less than 30 feet away! Couldn't identify them. 
This app Is no use to me. 

I know very well that the iPhone 6s plus has a very sensitive mic. 

A waste of money.

Awesome. Convenient and helpful. This has helped identify birds that we have not seen before. Matching the song is so much easier than trying to read the books with musical representations. Keep adding those songs!
Waste of money. Based on previous reviews I bought this app. It couldn't identify an American Robin and other common birds. Plan to ask for a refund
Absolutely awesome. Love to be able to identify all the singers in our fields. Live in the Florida woods and have MANY feathered visitors. Thanks!
Helpful. Easy to use , good info

Delightful app!. For someone who grew up surrounded by northern song- (and other) birds, I've always felt woefully ignorant about their songs. This app has helped me to begin to match up the birdcalls I hear with those I can identify visually, as well as to identify those whose names I only knew. Very pleasing thank you!
I like it a lot!. It helps me
Me. Very helpful!
Awesome app. This app does very well for identifying birds songs
Love it. I love this app
Great app!. Great app! Finally "Shazam" for birding! Can't wait to try it.

Not as helpful as I hoped. I have tried this a few times and the system always claims poor audio quality on recording and no match. 

Twice I was right next to the bird and they had loud distinct calls. Maybe the recording in a typical neighborhood is the issue. Phone mic tests showed clear recording. 

I then reviewed entire list of birds in library and found selection for my state (AZ) to be very limited. I am better off finding what I need on internet lookup. Nice idea, but for me, product not developed enough.
Great concept, mixed results. Admittedly limited use, but it has failed to identify birds singing their hearts out, within a few feet of the mic.
Like it, but not always accurate if calls are quieter. Recommend
Love the app. Love the app
Love it. Just what I've been waiting for love this app. Able to identify tons of birds just by hearing their song.

Most incredible bird ID app ever. I really enjoy birdwatching and this app is the only app I am aware of that will record and identify bird calls and songs. It is truly incredible. Several birds in my backyard have been elusive with their calls, and this app help me not only identify them but archived the recording for future playback. I also discovered the birds in my backyard love to hear birds of their kind calling, it is so fun to play bird calls back on a loop in the app and watch the birds in my backyard flit around in excitement as they hear the bird calls from the app. 10 out of 10!
When doves cry. 💯🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥💯

Needs better mic pickup. I can't get this ap to record a single thing! I level on the edge of a forest and my birds are loud and plentiful. I have an iPhone 7, so it's not the hardware. 
I really want to give this ap a good review but it's not there yet. I will change my rating once the mic actually records anything and I find out what I'm hearing! I had great hope but am currently disappointed.
great app. not a birder, but for what it's worth, this is a great app

Not worth it. Just get the Merlin Bird ID app. It's free and has more birds and calls. On its own this app isn't horrible but why spend your money if you can get a better quality app with more information for free.
Fabulous App. Being a amateur to mid bird watcher this app is fantastic. I also recently moved to a new state and it is great getting to know the birds here using the app too!
Great tool. Good easy to use
Pure fun. Whether on our deck in the San Jacinto mountains or sitting along the Mississippi in the evening, we never miss an opportunity to learn about our forest friends.
Love this app. This is my go to app when I'm outside listening to birds

keep up the good work. Love the concept - and when it works it's terrific. Most of the time the microphone doesn't pick up the bird call even when it's close by. Sometimes it's wildly off. But I'm glad I paid for it. One of the appeals is it's a great way to learn bird calls.

My favorite app. I'm a photographer who recently started photographing birds. This app is great and identifies my little friends and then lets me play back their songs and calls. The interface could use a little work but still my favorite app!
Nice app. It works pretty well, but often the correct bird is not the top one.

YES!. I read some reviews before purchasing that made me skeptical of the abilities that this app would have. However, they were completely off!! This app is a genuine pleasure to use. I mostly enjoy it because it's convenient and extremely helpful. The quiz function is probably a favorite because I love learning new things by being quizzed! It identifies the birds the birds that I hear very rapidly as well! Learning bird sounds is probably the single most important skill in moving from beginning birding to intermediate birding . This app is worth all the money in the world and I was more than glad to pay just $5.

Poor Automatic Recognition Performance. I bought this app to auto-recognize bird species from a piece of recorded clip, but it did not work. For a second time I tried to record a very simple bird call from the neighborhood, but the app still did not recognize the species. I am doubtful if this function works at all. Also the app does not allow you to use any recorded clips to run auto-recognition, even from your recording list in the App. You MUST record live to run auto-recognition.
Very good app. Very accurate and precise. Helpful with identification.

Very useful and accurate!. I love this app. As a amateur birder, it’s really helped me learn, discover and enjoy birds. It's made it much easier for me to get that practice in through the automatic recognition feature and by organizing songs into useful groups. Th app contains basic information for each species and beautiful, high-quality pictures. It also includes one song example and call notes per species. The app also really engaging and really goes the extra mile to help you identify birds more easily. I really enjoy how it turns practice sessions into fun quizzes. especially love the way the game plays the song and shows you multiple choice answers while also giving you an option to get a hint for the song. The game also gives you a sense of achievement by tracking your score and comparing it with other users so you can check on your progress. Love it and really recommend it!
Great app for those starting up. I am a long time birder but I use this app to help teach people that want to learn.

The Only One. I find this App very-very helpful. When looking for birds one often hears them long before seeing one. Knowing what sounds to expect helps locate seldom seen birds.

A very useful App it's only weakness is not very many bird IDENTIFIED.

Really fun and helpful. Living in the middle of nowhere has its benefits, there are tons of birds. I want to know what they are and this app helped me figure it out. I have woodpeckers, blue jays and so many more! I love it.
Helpful and Fun. Works very well!
Excellent app. This app is a genuine pleasure to use. Simultaneously entertaining and educational.
!. Great app! Very accurate
Beautiful app. I truly love this app. I use it so much. I loved birds before but it has helped me appreciate them even more. A lot of info great pics but the sounds are not that clear and good.

Great!. For the one who was complaining about not being "specific" about what phone used. I'm using the old school iPhone 5. It works great on mine. It does its job and yes it sometimes records poorly but that all depends where you are and how many sounds it picks up. I live in a neighborhood sometimes loud sometimes not. But over all it does what it says. I really enjoy using it. For 9.99 it is worth it in my opinion.

Excellent!. Reminds me of my days in Girl Guides where you needed to be able to identify birds just by their sounds to earn a badge. Love it & highly recommend it. Anyone interested in figuring out which bird you are hearing outside your window, just record the sound & the app identifies it for you! You can even build your own library. Wonderful tool for outdoor enthusiasts or the hermit who is just curious. Very happy with this app.

Location Challenged. Doesn't account for where you are birding. The birds shown are not of this area at all. Waste of my money. Inaccurate call ID. Should be able to narrow choices significantly but doesn't. Call of the Mt Chickadee unrecognizable.
like it!. Like the bird sounds!

So far very good app. Only had this app for few days so I can't attest to the long-term benefits but so far I'm very much enjoying. I can't wait to get out away from traffic to record some calls and see how that aspect works

Works as described. This app works well as is in my low noise farm environment. Interestingly, it seems to work best when I use a Sennheiser BT noise cancelling headset (MM550X) instead of the built-in. Experimentation needed to see if improvement is due to better microphone, directionality, less iPhone to hand contact noise, etc.
Wonderful app. I really enjoy using this app. The user interface is nice and clear -- easy to use, there's a huge selection of birds, and the bird songs & calls are great. Highly recommended.
Does the job. What I said. What more could you want?

No load. Installed 3 times and it always fails to load. Never opens......
Epic fail. Uninstalled.

App review. Good app!

Backyard birding. Great for the backyard. In the morning while having coffee it is great fun to identify the birds. Sounds I have heard my whole life now have an identity! I really enjoy the company of my bird friends even more.
Cool. Good bird app. Can tell you what bird it is by the sound of the call.

Birdsong. An excellent app. I'm a novice birder but have found this app to help identify songs/calls when out hiking even tho I may not see the bird.

Teaches me how to recognize. This app is great - IF you can get a voluble bird willing to vocalize close to you for 30 seconds. I've learned a number of common birds by their calls - or at least educated guesses. And it's fun to guess along with the app

I've tried and tried.... I have another bird identification app so I bought this for the song recognition feature. It has never worked for me. Great fun. A wonderful way to learn the birds in the neighborhood
Wonderful. Photos are lovely. Identifying birds is much easier now. Great app
Fun to learn.. I got the app because I kept hearing a beautiful bird somewhere in the backyard. Unfortunately I never figured it out but it's fun to play with.

Want a refund 😏. I've had no luck with this app . I guess the bird has to come chirp into my phone ! I can't understand the reviews that are positive . Maybe some that are wanting to identify their pet bird ...idk .
Great fun and helpful, too!. We just started using this app, but we're already learning bird calls and songs in its data base, as well as identifying birds on our 7 acre property.
DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY. Poor quality bird call samples. My recordings were better, but the app incorrectly identified the birds. Very disappointing

DO NOT BUY. Couldn't identify a cardinal that was approximately 15 feet away. I live in the middle of no where, so no background noise was present. The positive reviews on here are either bogus or people are within less than 15 feet of the bird at which point this software is useless.
Fun app. Fun app
Great, easy to use. This is a great app for quick easy identification of bird song. It's easy to use and sounds great.

Not for upper Midwest. The number/selection of birds included in this app makes no sense to my area (Minnesota). It includes birds that I will never hear (parrots, other southern birds) but doesn't include birds that I do hear (American Goldfinch, most warblers and finches). All the time you are holding it, you are worried that the quality of the recording is good enough (it can’t be too quiet, etc.). But it won’t tell you anything until you make the full recording. If it’s a good recording, then it gives you about a dozen bird choices. Yes, a dozen. Assuming you are like me and could only get a glimpse of the bird in the tree, the pictures don’t really help. So then you have to play each bird recording to see what you think is closest. Some bird calls are quite similar (which makes sense to me as to why they give a dozen choices). But it’s all up to me to figure it out. I’m not a bird expert that’s why I bought the app. So I am still guessing.

Also, when using it, It is incredibly easy to lose your recording before you’re done. I am bouncing between playing different bird calls and it is easy to hit a soft key that takes you back out of the analysis section. If you leave that section, you lose your recording. Then you have to try make a new recording, hoping all the time that the bird is still near you and singing and that you get a good quality recording. and of course, it takes a long time to make the new recording before you can analyze it . . .

My main issue with this app is the fact that you have to be virtually right on top of the bird for the recording to be of a quality that can provide the app with data sufficient for bird ID. I was recording right under a tree in which a bird was singing, pointing the microphone of my smart phone at the source, extended at arms length, and although that song was plenty loud to my ears it was not adequate for the app to make an adequate recording. As a result, I find the app essentially worthless for bird identification via song or call recognition. 

Based on my aforementioned experience, I can only conclude that one can seldom be sufficiently close to a bird in the wild for this app to be of any use. Perhaps it might be helpful if you were standing right next to birds clustering around a birdfeeder, but then you wouldn't need the app to identify the bird, would you? 

Also, I did not find the bird identification to be very accurate, even in identifying common birds. After many unsuccessful tries, I actually managed to make a fairly decent recording of a robin's song, and the app couldn't even identify such a common birdsong. I had to scroll through and play the various songs of different birds using trial and error in order to match the songs. Not helpful! 

I do like the fact that within the app you can select a particular bird and play its song, and the app will play that bird's song continuously, which provides very nice background ambience -- very pleasing to listen to through headphones! However, that function is not the reason that I obtained the app. 

I also wish that the makers of this app offered one which could identify western & U.S. Rocky Mountain region birds.

not useful waste of money. One star is being very generous -
unlike other recognition bird song apps, you must first record your bird, and then I guess play it back and then supposedly you were told what it is- but searching their database there are many birds in the USA, which are not listed in the bird app for instance American bitterns under tanagers there are none listed Western Scarlet, etc. there are no sparrows listed outside of a house sparrow. Could not recognize birds. Doesn’t work. Had perfectly clear sound to record. Suggested few birds with sound not even close.

Dissappointed in every aspect. I purchased this app hoping that it would help me and my wife to identify the birds that we commonly hear from our window. We live in Eastern Canada and the app failed to recognize most calls and songs. Navigating through the bird lists proved unnecessarily cumbersome, and the bird families groupings are not complete enough to be useful. Also, many recordings are either missing, or are too quiet to be of much use. In the end, I choose to delete this app despite having paid for it because it isn’t useful enough to justify the large quantity of storage space (>270MB) that it consumes.

Mad Moose Al. I like the app in theory. I haven’t used it enough to really rate it effectively. The one problem I’ve had is getting clear recordings. Years ago I got a parabolic reflector and recorded songs with a camcorder. The problem was matching the recordings with typical published bird songs. 

I am upgrading to a microphone designed for use with iPhone. If it works with the parabolic reflector and app it should solve both problems. 

Keeping my fingers crossed.

needs big improvement. If you are an ultra amature looking for backyard birds, this mightbe adequate, but it is very poor at recognizing anything remotely unusual. It requires a 30 second recording clip to properly analyze a song. How many birds sing continuously for 30 seconds?? I am afraid I classify this as a total waste of money. We took it on a trip to birding central ie Point Pelee - and it failed completely to recognize anything but a robin, and even that was an uncertain result. It needs to recognize very short songs and recordings to be useful. I couldn't even get it to recognize simple songs from the Cornell site played from my computer.

Poor app. Pretty disappointing. 20 feet away from a loud woodpecker and this app could not identify this bird. I have been unsuccessful at identifying any bird in sight with this app. Need substantial improvement to justify the price.
